Charlize Theron shaved her eyebrows and gained between 20 and 30 pounds (10 – 15kg) for her Oscar Winning role in 𝐌𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟑).⁣
⁣
She said that after she won the Oscar, instead of people talking about her acting abilities, she had to deal with every interviewer obsessing over how a pretty, thin person could possibly be “brave” enough to gain weight and, as it has since become known in the industry, “go ugly.” When the first photo stills from Monster were published, no one could believe that Theron would downplay her ‘greatest asset’ to become a homeless lesbian prostitute and serial k*ler.”⁣
⁣
